notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content: Fixed "recent winners" leaderboard only showing 1 entry

notes.title: Snake Jump 1.1 Small Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed mouse cursor dissappearing after pressing back from multiplayer
Fixed a button being grey
Fixed "Juicu chicken nugget" achievement not working
Fixed textures not loading at the top
Removed teleporter in multiplayer since it could cause lag to other players
Replaced "recent winners" with a podium in multiplayer (recent winners is still available in singleplayer)
